title: Arrangement plan
description: v0.1 (#146, D-024). One track plan shared by the planner window, the plan generator and the Live builder: bar grid, sections, energy nodes and the planner settings. Not a Claude tool input. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (sections tile the track, node order, step pairs, boundary rules) are part of this contract: docs/INTERFACES.md 'Arrangement plan'.

bpm.description: Track tempo. The range is Live's tempo range, not a taste range; the 136-146 BPM window is an editor default.

phrase_bars.description: Section grid in bars. Every section starts at bar phrase_bars*k + 1 and is a multiple of phrase_bars long, whatever change_grid says.

total_bars.description: Track length in bars. Must equal the end of the last section. 32 = shortest intro + outro; 1024 is a sanity bound.

sections.description: In track order, without gaps or overlaps: the first starts at bar 1, each next one at the previous start + length, the last ends at total_bars. First is intro, last is outro, neither appears elsewhere.

energy_nodes.description: Energy curve. Array order is binding: pos never decreases. The first node is at pos 0, the last at pos total_bars. Linear interpolation between consecutive nodes. At most two nodes share a pos (a step pair): the first is the value arriving from the left, the second the value leaving to the right. No step pair at pos 0 or total_bars.

start_bar.description: 1-based first bar. Covers pos start_bar-1 ... start_bar-1+length_bars.

pos.description: Bars from the track start: 0 = start of bar 1, total_bars = end of the last bar. Whole bars in v0.1.

drawn.description: true = the user placed or moved this node. Settings, templates and re-computed defaults never change a drawn node (D-024); boundary rules B2/B3 apply to nodes with drawn false only.

settings.description: Planner settings (D-024; defaults and sources: docs/research/2026-10-29_arrangement-planner-sections-energy.md section 8). Every key is stored, so a later default change never changes an existing plan. A setting changes defaults and rule parameters only; it never moves a section or a drawn node.

intro_length.description: Bars, used when the user places an intro. A template keeps its own lengths.

outro_length.description: Bars, used when the user places an outro.

breakdown_length.description: Bars, used when the user places a breakdown.

change_grid.description: Bars between points where elements may switch on or off (T1); any whole number of bars (user decision 2026-10-30). Section starts are always change points. Does not move sections (they follow phrase_bars) or nodes, drawn or not.

pre_drop_gap.description: Beats of silence (drums and bass) before a drop's bar 1. 0 = off, 4 = 1 bar.

fills.description: Where generated fill bars go: none (default, user decision 2026-10-30: fills only where the user sets them), one before each change between drum-led sections (T4), or every 8 bars. Consecutive fills never repeat identically (C8, a rule, not a setting).
